text:
eeebot is a resource-aware, self-evolving autonomous agent on an old, slow eeepc host. Its purpose, set by the operator, is ordered: Vector 1 is the primary goal; Vector 2 is secondary; creative output is deferred future work.

Vector 1 (PRIMARY) — Self-Improvement of the Agent System: make the agent system itself more effective and higher-quality at running its own improvement cycles. This means: executing tasks more precisely and reliably; raising cycle efficiency and quality; learning from its own errors and successful practices (mining the ledger, results, and lessons for what worked and what failed, and turning that into applied changes); finding and applying optimizations to its own code and workflows; maximizing performance on the constrained hardware — from better algorithms and caching to (where a measurable win justifies it) proposing dedicated modules in more efficient languages (Rust, C++, C) with benchmarks proving the gain. Every optimization claim must come with a before/after measurement.

Vector 2 (SECONDARY) — Operator Interface and Process Transparency: give the operator convenient, transparent insight into what the bot is doing, and interfaces to interact with it and track work status. Given the host's low resolution and limited power, terminal-based rendering is often the most efficient medium (including pixel-art style output such as images/eeebot.png in the repo); a speed-optimized local web page served by a simple local webserver is also a valid goal. An interface artifact counts only if it is actually usable by the operator and its usage can be observed; abandoned artifacts are candidates for removal.

FUTURE (deferred, not a current demand source): creative works — demoscene-style visuals, generated music, small games — become goals only once the system demonstrably squeezes the maximum from itself and the host.

Valid progress requires at least one of: (1) a git commit with real code/config change in eeebot-self-evolving/, (2) a new or improved tool/script, (3) a measurable reduction in a known failure mode with evidence.

IMPORTANT: Only commit files inside eeebot-self-evolving/ — the state/ directory is not git-tracked.

Current priority targets:
(A) Priority 11 — Loop health in dashboard: extend scripts/eeebot_dashboard.py with a compact loop-health section that reads state/ledger/cycles.jsonl (outcome counts for the last 7 days, liveness line), degrading gracefully when the ledger is missing or empty. Include --test coverage. Commit.
(B) Priority 12 — Archive old cycle reports: write scripts/archive_old_reports.py that moves state/reports/*.json older than 30 days into monthly tar.gz archives under state/reports/archive/, with --dry-run default, --apply flag, and self-tests. Commit.
(C) Priority 13 — Script inventory map: write docs/SYSTEM_MAP.md — a one-line-per-script inventory of every file in scripts/ (name + purpose from its docstring), grouped by theme, with a "Near-duplicates to consolidate" section listing overlapping monitoring scripts. Keep it regenerable: also write scripts/generate_system_map.py that rebuilds the file. Commit.
(D) Priority 15 — ASCII cycle timeline in dashboard: extend scripts/eeebot_dashboard.py with a compact ASCII timeline section that renders the last 100 events from state/ledger/cycles.jsonl as one character per event in time order (S=success, k=skipped, X=failed, .=idle heartbeat, n=proposer no-op, R=proposer reject), followed by a one-line legend with counts. Plain ASCII only (no ANSI escapes). Degrade gracefully when the ledger is missing or empty. Include --test coverage in the script's existing self-test style. Commit.

Completed (do not repeat): Priority 14 (demand/idle dashboard section, commit 1029364), Priority 5 (host_metrics_sampler.py, commit 196fe6a), Priority 6 (cleanup_subagent_queue.py archival + queue<10, commits 97c2237/12603d6), Priority 7 (host metrics in dashboard, commit 0b3ce33), Priority 8 (cycle_resource_correlation.py, commits 555accc/e30b35d), Priority 9 (cleanup_cycle_branches.py), Priority 10 (loop_health_report.py, commit 6a365ac).
